assertion.statement: For an inflated normalized sign cocycle and a Dirichlet character with its local square boundaries, a continuous cochain eta in mu_(2m) satisfies eta^2=chi and delta(eta)=epsilon.
assertion.objects: A normalized sign cocycle epsilon inflated from Gal(L/Q), its chosen Dirichlet character chi of order m, and a finite scalar cochain eta.
assertion.hypotheses: L/Q is finite Galois and unramified outside the finite set T containing 2; the prescribed local order-two invariants determine chi.
assertion.quantifiers: For every element and pair of elements of G_Q; all finite places and the real place enter the class comparison.
assertion.parameter_range: No odd-order restriction on chi or the sign class; the same original L and T are retained.
assertion.uniformity: A single continuous cochain supplies the identity at every coefficient prime.
assertion.constants: eta takes values in mu_(2m), eta^2=chi, and delta(eta)=epsilon.
assertion.normalizations: Roots of unity are constant coefficient modules in the square sequence; eta is generally a cochain, not a character on G_Q.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The real invariant is forced by the global Brauer sequence. A nontrivial sign class is not discarded.
assertion.limit_order: Match local square boundaries, use global injectivity including infinity, then choose a finite continuous square-root cochain.

assertion.uniformity: One finite collection of maps and algebraic scalars serves every coefficient prime.

assertion.exceptional_cases: The full-End=B assumption excludes the CM matrix-algebra case. Degree normalization is valid also for rational denominators.
assertion.limit_order: First form the rational central discrepancy, then normalize degree. Only later split the sign cocycle.
